editorial.blurb: This beloved Wicker Park sushi gem earns fierce loyalty with impeccably fresh fish, generous rolls, and a staff so genuinely caring they've chased down forgotten drinks.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mushroom miso soup and salmon ceviche—they're must-tries. The chef will happily customize heat levels on soups, and it's BYOB, so grab a beer from the liquor store across the street.
